inspiration: Rare roaming creature with a spawn enum: implings/ImplingSpawn.java (enum at line 36) defines the spawn set; ImplingType.java sits beside it (not opened). Recreate as a rare critter with a small table of spawn types, drawn with our own silhouette.

Respawn countdown that outlives the boss: bosstimer/RespawnTimer.java (class at line 32) and Boss.java line 75 comment say the timer keeps showing after a boss despawns. Recreate as a timer that stays on the minimap ring after a foe leaves, with our own presentation.

Colour-blind correction as a blend, not a switch: gpu/colorblind.glsl line 10 comment and line 11 uniform blend between the original colour and a corrected colour by an intensity value. Recreate as a 0 to 1 slider on our colour grade, with our own correction maths.
Interface skins as era folders: interfacestyles/2005, 2010 and rs3 hold full skin sets (307 files). Recreate as switchable skin families for our HUD, with our own art.

Region-keyed visibility overrides: roofremoval/overrides.jsonc keys each region id to a list of rectangles with height limits. Recreate zone-level visibility as a per-zone override table in the zone data.

Separate UI and world shaders: gpu/vertui.glsl and fragui.glsl are their own pair, apart from the world shader. Recreate a UI pass that is independent from the world grade, so HUD stays sharp on a grade change.
Pixel-art-aware upscalers: gpu/scale/xbr_lv2_*.glsl and bicubic.glsl are edge-aware scalers. Recreate a small set of filters for low-res sprites at 375 wide.

briefs.label: rare roaming critter marker (own label)
briefs.why: Rare and readable: a small roaming creature with an outline and a name tag. One signature behaviour: it spawns on a timer and wanders. One signature sound: a chime on spawn. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance.
briefs.keep: a rare spawn type with its own enum of variants and a readable tag
briefs.change: our own creature silhouette, a different spawn rule and no outline. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: boss respawn ring (own label)
briefs.why: A ring or timer that keeps counting after the foe leaves reads at 375 wide. One signature effect: a countdown ring. One signature sound: none needed. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance.
briefs.keep: a respawn countdown that stays visible after the boss despawns
briefs.change: a minimap ring instead of a text list, our own colours. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: colour-blind intensity dial (own label)
briefs.why: An intensity dial lets players pick their own correction strength; it is an accessibility feature that costs one uniform. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance.
briefs.keep: a 0 to 1 blend between the original and corrected colour
briefs.change: our own correction maths and a slider with a preset, not an on or off toggle. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: era skin family (own label)
briefs.why: Three skin folders show how a HUD skin family is organised. One signature trait: one skin per era. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance. Class C: category-level only
briefs.keep: switchable skin families, one folder per family
briefs.change: our own art, our own family names and a different panel shape. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy
